name: delivereeos-bridge
description: Connect Codex delivery tasks to scoped DelivereeOS projects, work items, and knowledge evidence.

interface.shortDescription: Deliver scoped PBIs and sync evidence.
interface.longDescription: Links a Codex task to one DelivereeOS project conversation. Codex can read selected work, claim PBIs, report progress, submit truthful completion evidence, and return missing scope for review.
defaultPrompt: Claim the selected PBI and implement it.
Sync progress and evidence to DelivereeOS.
